cards.title: CHMOD
cards.description_long: The 'chmod' command modifies file or directory permissions. You can use symbolic (rwx) or numeric (octal) notation to set read, write, and execute permissions.

main_commands.explanation: Set permissions to rwxr-xr-x (owner full, group and others read/execute)
Set permissions to rw-r--r-- (owner read/write, group and others read only)
Add execute permission to a file
Recursively set folder and contents to rwx for owner only
Set custom symbolic permissions for user, group, and others

activity: Set a script file as executable
Restrict folder permissions to owner only
Set read/write permissions for owner and read-only for others

cards.title: CHOWN
cards.description_long: The 'chown' command changes the owner of a file or directory. You can also change both owner and group at the same time.

main_commands.explanation: Change owner of file.txt to user alice
Change owner to alice and group to developers
Recursively change owner of folder and its contents
Change file owner to root (requires sudo)
Set target.txt owner same as ref.txt

activity: Recursively change owner of a folder
Use sudo to change owner to root
Copy owner permissions from one file to another

cards.title: CHGRP
cards.description_long: The 'chgrp' command changes the group ownership of a file or directory. Useful when collaborating in shared directories.

main_commands.explanation: Change the group of file.txt to developers
Recursively change group of folder and its contents
Set target.txt group same as ref.txt
Change group to staff using sudo
Change group to current user’s primary group

activity: Change group ownership of a file
Recursively change group of a folder
Use reference file to assign group
Assign current user’s primary group to a file
